title: Visual Studio 2022 version 17.9.7
body_markdown:
*released May 14th, 2024*

### Summary of What's New in this release

* The "Xamarin" and "Xamarin Profiler" installer components have been marked "Out of support".
* This release also includes an OpenSSL update to v3.2.1

### Security advisories addressed

* [**CVE-2024-32002**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-32002) Recursive clones on case-insensitive filesystems that support symlinks are susceptible to Remote Code Execution.
* [**CVE-2024-32004**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-32004) Remote Code Execution while cloning special-crafted local repositories
* [**CVE-2024-30045**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-30045) A Remote Code Execution vulnerability exists in .NET 7.0 and .NET 8.0 where a stack buffer overrun occurs in .NET Double Parse routine.
* [**CVE-2024-30046**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-30046) A Vulnerability exists in Microsoft.AspNetCore.Server.Kestrel.Core.dll where a dead-lock can occur resulting in Denial of Service.
